scope: Only the two City blank standard-form professional-services agreements retained from the municipal-development procurement cluster.

source_verification.method: Downloaded only the two saved authoritative City PDF URLs to temporary local staging on 2026-09-19; each exact byte size and SHA-256 matched the saved research, and each began with the PDF signature. Saved research supplies the prior full-text-layer, page-count, and visual reading evidence; no broad source discovery was repeated.
source_verification.staging_note: Temporary originals are preparation evidence only. They were not uploaded, transformed, or used for public content.

family_assessment.relationship: Companion instruments, not duplicates. The saved research measured normalized-text ratio 0.9597 with asymmetric token coverage 0.9767 and 0.9691, then identified profession-specific scope and practice provisions.
family_assessment.publication_form: If the external archive gate is later authorized and passed, publish each original as a separate archived PDF under Public Infrastructure Cost Estimating on the Development Process page, explicitly labeled as a blank standard form rather than an executed contract.

placement_review.canonical_reason: The existing section already holds the validated consultant-compensation rules for engineers, architects, and landscape architects. These agreements supply the complementary terms those professions sign, without creating a new page or misrepresenting templates as project records.

cross_listing.reason: The Capital Spending page curates capital programs, bonds, allocations, and project scopes. A general blank agreement merely recites Capital Implementation Program funding and is neither a capital program nor a project-specific spending record; that indirect reference does not support a useful cross-listing.

archive_publication_gates: Obtain explicit authorization before any R2 upload, overwrite, or other storage mutation.
Archive each original unchanged at its proposed key, then verify its public archive download against the recorded exact size and SHA-256 while retaining the City source URL.

Only after successful public-byte verification, make the gated Development Process page edit and perform normal Hugo/repository validation. Do not add the rejected Capital Spending cross-listing unless a future editorial decision reverses it.
Do not mark either candidate implemented or validated before those archive and public-content gates pass.
